tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.compu.en: One more chestplate module slot; the shield costs %s MRU per point blocked
tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.compu.zh: 胸甲多一个模块槽；护盾每挡 1 点要 %s MRU

tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.compu.en: The shield also blocks magic cast by monsters (a witch's potions, an evoker's fangs and the like), at %s times the cost per point
tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.compu.zh: 护盾也挡怪物施放的魔法伤害（女巫的药水、唤魔者的尖牙这类），这种每点电费是平时的 %s 倍

tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.compu.en: One more helmet and leggings slot; with all four pieces at stage 3, you heal %2$s%% of your max health every second after %1$s seconds unhurt (Matrix Repair)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.compu.zh: 头盔、护腿各多一个模块槽；四件都到 3 阶时，%s 秒没受伤就每秒回 %s%% 最大生命（矩阵修复）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.compu.en: The shield costs %s MRU per point; it also blocks %s%% of armor-piercing damage from monsters, at %s times the cost per point
tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.compu.zh: 护盾每挡 1 点要 %s MRU；怪物打来的无视护甲伤害也挡 %s%%，这种每点电费是平时的 %s 倍

tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.compu.en: One more boots slot; with all four pieces at stage 5, when the shield blocks a hit worth %s%% of your max health or more, nothing can hurt you for %s seconds (Overload Barrier, at most once every %s seconds)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.attunement.compu.zh: 靴子多一个模块槽；四件都到 5 阶时，护盾一下挡掉你最大生命的 %s%% 以上，之后 %s 秒什么都伤不到你（过载屏障，每 %s 秒最多一次）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.computer_armor.s.en: Also blocks its share of magic damage from monsters (%s MRU per point)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.computer_armor.s.zh: 怪物打来的魔法伤害也挡它那一份（每点 %s MRU）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.computer_armor.s.en: Blocks %s of its share of armor-piercing damage from monsters (%s MRU per point)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.computer_armor.s.zh: 怪物打来的无视护甲伤害，挡它那一份的 %s（每点 %s MRU）

gui.essentialcraft5.computer_terminal.mo.zh: %s · %s 个模块槽（同调多给 %s 个）
